title: Equivariant formal Cohen presentations with prime-to-ell invariant quotient
statement:
Let $A$ be a complete Noetherian normal local domain of dimension $d\geq2$, and let $\ell$ be a prime whose image in $A$ is a unit. There exist a complete Noetherian normal local domain $B$, a finite group $H$ acting on $B$ by local ring automorphisms, a coefficient subring $V\subseteq B$ preserved by $H$, an integer $r\geq1$, and an injective local ring map
$$R=V[[t_1,\ldots,t_r]]\longrightarrow B$$
which is finite as a module and $H$-equivariant, where $H$ fixes every $t_i$. There is an injective module-finite local map $A\to A^+=B^H$, the fixed subring, and $[\operatorname{Frac}(A^+):\operatorname{Frac}(A)]$ is prime to $\ell$. The order of $H$ is invertible in $V$. The map $V\to B$ induces an isomorphism on residue fields. In equal characteristic one can take $H=\{1\}$, $B=A^+=A$, $V$ a coefficient field and $r=d$. In mixed characteristic $(0,p)$ one can take $H$ an $\ell$-group, $V$ a complete discrete valuation ring of residue characteristic $p$, and $r=d-1$. In both cases there is $f\in R$ whose reduction modulo $\mathfrak m_V$ is nonzero, such that $R[1/f]\to B[1/f]$ is etale. Put $\Lambda=V^H$. This is a field in the field case and a complete discrete valuation ring in the discrete valuation case. The invariant formal ring is $R^H=\Lambda[[t_1,\ldots,t_r]]$. For every $0\leq j\leq r$, $\Lambda[[t_1,\ldots,t_j]]$ is complete regular Noetherian local of dimension $j$ in the field case and $j+1$ in the discrete valuation case, and $\ell$ is a unit in it.

Here a normal local domain is an integrally closed domain, a group action means a homomorphism into ring automorphisms, and the fixed subring consists of the elements fixed by every group element. Completeness and power series have the meanings of [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion], [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series]; Noetherianity, dimension, regularity, discrete valuation rings, finite modules, and etaleness are as in [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring], [def-weil-regular-scheme], [def-sc-discrete-valuation-ring], [def-weil-finitely-generated-module], [def-weil-etale-morphism].
